description: This header file defines the interface for the Cert IPSec Manager component, including function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of the manager object. It declares external functions for managing the Cert IPSec manager object within a platform-independent environment.

methods.name: PkiCreateCertIpsecManager
methods.description: Creates a Cert IPSec Manager object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: CertIpsecMgrCreate
methods.description: Creates a Cert IPSec Manager instance with specified contexts.

methods.name: CertIpsecMgrRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Cert IPSec Manager object.

methods.name: CertIpsecMgrEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Cert IPSec Manager.

methods.name: CertIpsecMgrInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Cert IPSec Manager object.
